reason: I'm at the counter from 7 to 2 and I don't want another app, another login, and my staff fumbling with PINs while customers wait. Creators already message me on WhatsApp, so I don't see why I need this.
objection: Free now, but once my staff and creators are used to it you'll start charging, and the ₹200 a month is pilot money that will disappear.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked fully on WhatsApp with no new app or sign-in, and a salon owner I know showed me it actually brought paying customers.
